definition: An informal socioeconomic designation below Tier 1 — individuals who exist outside the corponation registry entirely, with no verified identity, no UBC access, and no legal standing. Neither citizens nor synthetics, they are bureaucratically invisible.
origin: Social welfare activist terminology; also used by Ferrogate Security as an internal classification
usage: Social workers, Shelf community organizers, law enforcement, underworld brokers
example: Half the people living under the Overhang are ghost tier — they don't exist on any registry, which means they don't exist at all, legally speaking.
